title: Indeed Jobs - Search, Salaries & Company Names
description: Minimal input {"queries": ["python"], "locations": ["New York"], "countries": ["US"], "maxResults": 3, "maxSources": 1}. $0.002 per valid source check plus $0.0015 per delivered job. Filtered sources are paid. No start fee. maxTotalChargeUsd is a run option.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Keyword searches, e.g. ["python"] for Indeed or ["budget planner"] for Google Play. Up to 20; any language. Indeed requires locations; Google Play accepts queries, appIds or both. Each query/location/country (Indeed) or query/country (Play) is one paid source check. First public results response only; no pagination.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Required Indeed search locations, e.g. ["New York"] or ["Toronto"]. Up to 20. Use a city/region appropriate to countries; "Remote" is also a source search location. Each query/location/country combination is a paid source check. remoteOnly separately filters the returned source remote flag.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Country storefront/search editions, e.g. ["US"] (default), ["GB"] or ["DE", "JP"]. Not developer nationality or an IP-geolocation guarantee. Indeed supports US, GB, CA only. Google Play supports US, GB, CA, AU, DE, FR, JP, IN, AE, SG, BR, ES, IT. Each country multiplies source checks. Prices retain local currencies.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the ENTIRE run after filters, exclusions and deduplication; default 20, range 1–1000. Earlier targets can fill it. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in Apify run options for a dollar cap, not inside input JSON. A result cap does not expand source coverage.

hasSalary.title: Has salary
hasSalary.description: Indeed salary-text filter: "any" (default), "yes" or "no". "yes" keeps job cards with salary text; it does not validate or normalize pay, currency or pay period. Applied before maxResults. No filter fee; valid search checks remain paid.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: false (default) keeps all Indeed cards. true keeps only cards with source remote=true; unknown flags are excluded. It does not verify the employer policy or mean work from any country. Use suitable locations too. Filters before maxResults; no extra filter fee.

companyContains.title: Company contains
companyContains.description: Optional Indeed company-name OR phrases, e.g. ["Microsoft"]. [] disables. Filters returned search cards, not a company-directory lookup. Applied before maxResults. No extra filter fee; successful search checks are paid.

textContains.title: Text contains
textContains.description: Optional case-insensitive OR phrases, e.g. ["python", "developer"]. Matches title, caption/snippet/description, author, company or developer fields when present. [] disables. Filters before maxResults. Skipped rows have no row fee; valid source checks are paid.

maxSources.title: Max sources
maxSources.description: Maximum attempted source targets across the run; default 20, range 1–100. One post/video URL, Indeed query/location/country, or Play query-or-ID/country counts as one. Failed targets count toward this limit but have no event fee. Valid filtered sources are paid; retries add no source fee.

excludeIds.title: Exclude ids
excludeIds.description: Prior dataset id values, e.g. [] on a first run; up to 5,000. Skips identities even when changed. For Google Play use the full app:country:language id. Excluded rows are free but valid checks are paid. Keep history in your workflow; no automatic persistence.

excludeContentHashes.title: Exclude content hashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior content_hash values, e.g. [] initially; up to 5,000 SHA-256 hashes. Skips unchanged observations while allowing updates. Do not also exclude IDs when changes matter. Time, search position, image URLs and relative-date labels do not affect hashes. Valid source checks remain paid; no stored history.
